claims.text: The resort is at 17875 Collins Avenue in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida.

findings.quote: 17875 Collins Ave, Sunny Isles Beach, FL 33160

claims.text: Acqualina is a Mediterranean-inspired resort on the beach.

findings.quote: Acqualina is a Mediterranean-inspired haven on the pristine shores of Miami Beach

claims.text: Miami designer Isabel Tragash and her team designed the guest rooms.

findings.quote: Celebrated Miami designer Isabel Tragash and her team of designers imbued the hotel room design with their unique vision

claims.text: All guest rooms and suites have private balconies with views of the Atlantic Ocean or the Intracoastal Bay.

findings.quote: The spacious guestrooms and suites all have private balconies with breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean or the Intracoastal Bay.

claims.text: Every room and suite has a marble bathroom, Seed to Skin Tuscany amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi and an Illy espresso machine.

findings.quote: Every room and suite include a private balcony, marble bathroom, Seed to Skin Tuscany amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi, and an Illy espresso machine.

claims.text: Many suites have full gourmet kitchens.

findings.quote: Full gourmet kitchens are featured in many suites with sub-zero built-in refrigerator/freezer

claims.text: Ke-uH serves Japanese fusion cuisine at dinner, indoors and outdoors.

findings.quote: Ke-uH located inside Acqualina offers Japanese fusion cuisine for dinner service with indoor and outdoor dining options.

claims.text: The beachside Costa Grill is reserved for hotel guests, residents and Beach Club members.

findings.quote: Costa Grill is exclusively reserved for hotel guests, Acqualina residents, and Beach Club Members to preserve a serene, private atmosphere.
delivers casual beachside dining with a Floridian flair

claims.text: Spa guests can use a crystal steam room, sauna, Himalayan salt lounges and an outdoor spa terrace with a heated jet pool and Roman waterfall.

findings.quote: Spa guests have access to our crystal steam room, sauna, Himalayan salt lounges, experience showers, and our private outdoor spa terrace with a heated jet pool and Roman waterfall.

claims.text: The resort has three outdoor swimming pools; the oceanfront Adult Pool is for guests 18 and over.

findings.quote: Three outdoor swimming pools provide a haven for relaxation.
This oceanfront tranquility haven for guests 18 years and over
The Adult Pool

claims.text: The Recreational Pool hosts staff-led pool games, activities and aqua fitness classes.

findings.quote: The Recreational Pool is the epicenter of fun pool games, activities, aqua fitness classes, and other diversions led by Acqualina Resort’s staff.

claims.text: The resort is close to Bal Harbour Shops and Aventura Mall.

findings.quote: Acqualina is close to some of South Florida’s finest shopping destinations and some of the world’s best designers, including the world-famous Bal Harbour Shops and the expansive Aventura Mall.

claims.text: The marine-themed AcquaMarine program is complimentary for children ages 4 to 12, with lunch available at a cost.

findings.quote: AcquaMarine is complimentary for children ages 4 to 12, and a lunch option is available at a cost.
a marine-themed children’s program

claims.text: Acqualina Spa is a 20,000-square-foot, two-story spa with eleven treatment rooms and a private spa suite for two.

findings.quote: Acqualina Spa provides guests with an exquisite 20,000-square-foot, two-story tranquil sanctuary of relaxation set in a class of its own offering eleven multi-functional treatment rooms, and an extravagant private spa suite for two

claims.text: Beach service for hotel guests includes complimentary umbrellas, chaise lounges, towels and beach butler service.

findings.quote: exclusively available to Acqualina residents, hotel guests and beach club members and include complimentary beach umbrellas, complimentary chaise lounge, towel service and beach butler service.

claims.text: Guests reach Avra Miami, which serves Greek cuisine, by a short walk across a sky bridge.

findings.quote: With a short walk through an exclusive sky bridge adjacent to Acqualina Resort and within the resort community, guests can now enjoy a taste of Greece at Avra Miami.

claims.text: The resort offers a private 5.5-hour Everglades National Park tour with naturalists from Wild Lime Adventures.

findings.quote: Discover one of the world's most unique ecosystems on a private 5.5-hour tour of Everglades National Park with expert naturalists from Wild Lime Adventures.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler's reviewer noted the resort is a 30 to 40 minute drive from South Beach.

findings.quote: Deciding to stay a good 30-40 minute drive from South Beach

claims.text: AcquaMarine camp reservations are required at least 24 hours in advance.

findings.quote: Reservations are required at least 24 hours in advance for camps offered Friday through Sunday and select holidays.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's ultra-luxury positioning.
